description: This source file defines a custom Android TextView class called SkewableTextView, which allows skewing the text to the left or right, enabling anticipation and follow-through visual effects in animations.

classes.name: SkewableTextView
classes.description: A custom TextView that can be skewed horizontally to create animation effects such as anticipation and follow-through.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the default drawing method to apply skew transformation before drawing the text.

methods.name: getSkewX
methods.description: Returns the current skew value along the X axis.

methods.name: setSkewX
methods.description: Sets the skew value along the X axis and invalidates the view to trigger a redraw.

methods.name: invalidateSkewedBounds
methods.description: Calculates the skewed bounds of the view and invalidates that specific area for redrawing.
